Subject: Request: reassign reserved capacity + exhibit update

Hi Jordan,

Quick one from our side — we need to reassign 40k reserved tokens from the 'predictor-large' SKU to 'predictor-medium' for Q4 usage. Our engineering forecast has shifted and we expect more short-sequence traffic.

Can Redwood update Exhibit B to reflect the SKU reallocation and adjusted unit pricing (we expect a small credits/charge depending on price diff). I attached the current order form for reference.

Two asks:
- Can you confirm whether charges will be pro-rated for the remainder of our current billing month?
- We need to make the change effective 2026-09-20 if possible.

Tim (CFO) is cc'd for budget approval. Let me know what documents you need from our side; happy to sign a change order.

Thanks,
Kimberly Shaw
Head of Platform
Cinder Analytics

1) Sales Ops & Finance confirm proration approach.
2) Legal produces a short change order + redlined Exhibit B for your review.
3) We push DocuSign and target effective date 2026-09-20 if all signatories are ready.

Putting numbers behind this: attached is a SKU table with our unit costs. If we move 40k tokens from predictor-large to predictor-medium, the net delta for the remainder of Sept (prorated) is a credit of ~$1,120 to Cinder. For Oct onward, the monthly invoice will reflect the lower unit cost.

Recommended approach:
- Draft a one-page change order that: (a) reallocates 40k tokens, (b) states pricing for the remainder of the billing cycle will be pro-rated and applied as a credit (if negative), and (c) sets the effective date to 2026-09-20.
- Legal to produce redline of Exhibit B and include the updated SKU table.
